name: io.github.twittrapi/twittrapi-mcp
title: TwittrAPI
description: Read public Twitter/X data: tweets, profiles, followers, search. No X developer account.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your TwittrAPI key. Set this or RAPIDAPI_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: RAPIDAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RapidAPI key for the Twitter AIO API. Used when TWITTRAPI_API_KEY is not set.

environmentVariables.name: RAPIDAPI_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host of your TwittrAPI listing on RapidAPI. Change it if you subscribed to another listing.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_RESPONSE_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Format of tool results: simple (compact JSON, far fewer tokens) or raw (X's full GraphQL JSON). Tools also take a format argument.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_X_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Cookie of your own logged-in x.com session (auth_token, ct0, twid). With TWITTRAPI_X_PROXY set, adds the account tools (post, like, follow, DMs, lists, drafts).

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_X_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Your proxy for the account tools, http://user:pass@host:port.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_X_CHAT_PASSCODE
environmentVariables.description: Your X Chat passcode. Adds send_dm and message text in the DM inbox.
